method: Sauté tomatoes in a little oil. Add seedless/fiberless tamarind to it and sauté well.
Let the mixture cool down and then grind it in a mixer.
Heat gingelly oil in a pan. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add the peeled garlic and sauté. Then add the ground tomato paste and mix well.
Do not forget to add the chili powder and salt powder during this process.
Once it has cooled down completely, store it in a clean bottle.
notes: Note: Don't forget to add chili powder and salt powder.
